Extraction and flagging rules

34 and higher is flagged; exactly 33 is not. Automatic reads require exactly two digits, an OCR score of at least 0.92, and a visible ticket HUD. Selected peaks and sample records were checked visually. Manual corrections and unresolved reads are retained separately. The entire series is not manually verified.

Counts can change between frames. Flagged runs describe the observed samples, not exact crossing times or continuous exceedance durations. OCR scores are not calibrated probabilities. Short excursions between samples may be missed.

Which records enter the charts?

All 3 manually checked feed entries are included. Machine candidates need at least two observations, a best paired OCR confidence of at least 0.92, and known factions on both sides. Confidence is an OCR score, not a calibrated probability of correctness.

Readings from repeated frames are grouped by attacker and target while gaps remain at most 12.6 seconds. A later exchange by the same pair can be a separate record. Distinct combat-state changes within that window can be merged; icon types have not been fully classified.

Ticket checks and missing data

Ticket reads require three digits, a nearby supporting reading, monotonic progression, plausible growth, and consistency with 22 manually reviewed anchors. Rejected numeric reads remain in the review queue. Blank values mean unavailable, never zero. Control labels are machine-read observations.

Ticket review queue CSV
Names, factions and review

PHNT → Blue; PV → Red; AK-P and AK → Green, supported by the recorded icons and scoreboard. Other clan tags remain unknown. Close OCR spelling variants within a clan can be mapped to a more frequent reading; those mappings are inspectable and remain unreviewed.

Name aliases CSVUnparsed feed rows CSV
Map detection and spatial limits

A template match against the expanded-map control row detects likely map appearances at sampled frames. Runs may split if detection fails, and short openings between samples can be missed. Native map crops show what this POV could see. Green colour components are symbol candidates, not a count of people. Coordinates are relative to each cropped image; panning and zoom have not been registered to world coordinates. No inferred movement routes are drawn.

Evidence and timestamps

The source recording stays on this computer. Extracted images retain native-resolution left HUD crops plus an overview thumbnail. Filenames encode video presentation timestamps in milliseconds. Machine event times mark first observation; manually reviewed events retain tighter bounds. The exact frame test timestamps HUD text appearance, not the server's event time.

Original video remains offline. Selected excerpts and screenshots are included.
